title: How Employment is Changing at Anthropic
author_or_organization: Nathan Wilmers, Regina Catipon, Maxim Massenkoff, and Peter McCrory (The Anthropic Institute)
limitations: Internal mixed-methods study of Anthropic combining agent telemetry, a within-person staggered adoption panel (192 adopters vs. 74 non-adopters), commit-level code quality checks, Slack communication network graphs, calendar data, coded hiring scorecards, and 17 interviews. First-party study inside a hyper-growth AI lab with broad employee equity; tool adoption is non-random and conditions do not automatically generalize to low-growth firms.
